copy.en:
Choose from Three Handle Heights
An aluminum frame and hinged opening make access quicker than zipper-style cases.
Foldable phone holder on the handle
Polyester lining inside the case
copy.zh:
三档拉杆高度可调
铝合金框架配合铰链开合，比拉链箱开启更快捷
拉杆配备可折叠手机支架
箱内采用涤纶内衬
copy.de:
Drei Griffhöhen zur Auswahl
Aluminiumrahmen und Scharnieröffnung ermöglichen schnelleren Zugriff als Koffer mit Reißverschluss.
Klappbare Handyhalterung direkt am Griff
Polyesterfutter im Inneren des Koffers
copy.fr:
Trois hauteurs de poignée au choix
Le cadre en aluminium et l’ouverture articulée accélèrent l’accès face aux modèles zippés.
Support de téléphone pliable sur la poignée
Doublure intérieure en polyester
copy.it:
Tre altezze del manico selezionabili
Telaio in alluminio e apertura a cerniera consentono un accesso più rapido delle zip.
Supporto pieghevole per smartphone sul manico
Fodera interna in poliestere
copy.es:
Tres alturas de asa ajustables
El marco de aluminio y la apertura con bisagra agilizan el acceso frente a cremalleras.
Soporte plegable para móvil en el asa
Forro interior de poliéster

design_brief_zh: 主卖点为拉杆可进行三档高度调节，并以结构分解和真实局部放大证明，而非重复泛化的铝合金拉杆表达。PC采用2000×2000画布，左侧产品区严格位于[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]：使用单一枪灰色实物比例旅行箱，三分之四视角轻微打开，依次分层呈现外壳、铝合金框架、铰链连接、拉杆、折叠手机支架与涤纶内衬；用三个克制的半透明拉杆高度轮廓表现三档位置，避免画成三组实体拉杆。右侧文案区位于[0.57,0.10,0.38,0.80]，阅读顺序为标题、支持说明、手机支架标注、涤纶内衬标注；标题对应三档拉杆高度，字号最大并突出数字3，支持说明对应铝合金框架与铰链开合关系，两个细节行分别连接拉杆手机支架和箱内衬局部放大框。移动端单独按1200×1200重排：产品与结构区位于[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，完整保留三档拉杆、铰链和两个局部证据；底部文案区位于[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]，四行自上而下排列并保证德语约20%的横向扩展空间。画面边缘可放置无品牌、低对比度的普通拉链箱轮廓，仅辅助说明铰链开启相对快捷，不呈现计时、胜负或破坏性对比。采用欧洲现代旅行产品摄影、低饱和暖灰背景、自然侧光、柔和接触阴影，金属框保留真实且克制的反光；字体采用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线体，标题粗体，说明与标注常规字重。资料未提供材料厚度、结构截面尺寸或测试数据，因此不得以夸张厚度、数值或实验效果表现“厚实”，仅通过真实组件分层、边缘反光和连接关系展示结构。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的三档拉杆、拉杆上的可折叠手机支架、铝合金框架、铰链开合和涤纶内衬信息。不得把整只旅行箱描述为全铝箱；不得虚构框架厚度、内部零件、承重能力、耐冲击等级、测试结果、认证或安全保证。与拉链箱相比开启更快捷可作中性结构对比，但不得加入具体时间、绝对领先或竞品贬损。画面不得出现竞品商标、价格、评分、促销或官方背书。
image_prompt_en: Create an evidence-led exploded product visual for a premium modern travel suitcase, with absolutely NO rendered text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, watermarks, or typography. Use one consistent gunmetal-gray suitcase in accurate real-world proportions, shown from a three-quarter angle and slightly open. For the 2000×2000 desktop composition, place the product and exploded structure within normalized box [0.05, 0.08, 0.46, 0.84], leaving clean negative space for later copy within [0.57, 0.10, 0.38, 0.80]. Carefully separate only the verified visible components: PC/ABS shell panels, aluminum frame, hinged opening relationship, telescopic handle, foldable phone holder on the handle, and polyester interior lining. Show the three adjustable handle positions through three subtle translucent height silhouettes aligned to one real telescopic handle, not three separate physical handles. Add two clean unlabeled magnification insets with fine leader lines, one accurately targeting the foldable phone holder and one targeting the polyester lining. Preserve realistic hinge geometry and restrained metallic reflections. At the far edge, include a faint, unbranded neutral zipper-suitcase silhouette only as a secondary structural comparison, without timers, symbols, damage, or competitive branding. Use a low-saturation warm-neutral background, European modern travel-product photography, soft natural side lighting, realistic contact shadows, and crisp premium materials. Do not exaggerate material thickness and do not reveal or invent hidden internal parts. Also prepare a separately recomposed 1200×1200 mobile version with the product and structure inside [0.08, 0.05, 0.84, 0.53] and clear empty space for later copy inside [0.05, 0.64, 0.90, 0.31].
